550:t_1:87.en:
$$テッサ$$
($$レナード$$... I can't hand this world over to your ego...)

550:t_1:88.en:
$$テッサ$$
(We will stake our lives on that.)

550:t_1:92.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

550:t_1:93.en:
$$カレン$$
「...So because of that power, the 《$$ウィスパード$$》, $$かなめ$$ is being targeted by $$アマルガム$$.」

550:t_1:95.en:
$$アルト$$
「A power to receive all kinds of information from the future...」

550:t_1:96.en:
$n
「And because of it, the world as it is now has been changed from the way it was meant to be?」

550:t_1:97.en:
$$スザク$$
「And to correct that distortion, he'll remake the world...」

550:t_1:98.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That is $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$'s plan... In other words, a selfish spacetime restoration...」

550:t_1:99.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Is that $$時空震動弾$$ also for the sake of that power?」

550:t_1:101.en:
$$桂$$
(A true singularity... The key to spacetime restoration is $$かなめ$$ after all, huh.)

550:t_1:102.en:
$$キリコ$$
「That man curses the past, does he?」

550:t_1:104.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I can understand how he feels. But that is clinging to the past.」

550:t_1:105.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$キリコ$$ once lost $$フィアナ$$ to old age...」

550:t_1:106.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「If $$キリコ$$ had sided with $$ガドライト#pilot$$ and accepted the $$時の牢獄$$, $$フィアナ$$ might have gone on living...」

550:t_1:107.en:
$$カレン$$
「But $$キリコ$$ didn't choose that... He believes the past is the past...」

550:t_1:108.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That is the way of human beings.」

550:t_1:109.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That's why we mourn those who have died, and fight to reach an even slightly better future...」

550:t_1:110.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ asked me to convey her apology for keeping the existence of the $$ウィスパード$$ hidden, classified as it was.」

550:t_1:112.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Yeah... $$ミスリル$$ sent word to everyone of field-grade rank or above, as top-secret information.」

550:t_1:113.en:
$$オズマ$$
「But I want you to understand. That it was an unavoidable measure.」

550:t_1:114.en:
$n
「I'm not bothered. Whatever power she has, $$千鳥$$ is $$千鳥$$, and Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ is Captain $$テスタロッサ$$.」

550:t_1:115.en:
$$カレン$$
「Yeah... A friend of ours was kidnapped... So we're going to save her. That's all there is to it.」

550:t_1:118.en:
$$アルト$$
(You've been carrying this secret alone, fighting to protect $$かなめ$$...)

550:t_1:119.en:
$n
(You were protecting $$千鳥$$ from being looked at as someone special, too, weren't you?)

550:t_1:120.en:
$n
(For the day she can live a life where a power like that doesn't matter...)

550:t_1:121.en:
$$オズマ$$
「And she is the key to $$アマルガム$$'s... no, to $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$'s plan.」

550:t_1:122.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Getting her back is our objective in this operation. Remember that.」

550:t_1:124.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「...But what I don't understand is what those $$クロノ$$ Reformists are thinking.」

550:t_1:125.en:
$$レド$$
「What was the point of trying to destroy $$ヤムスク$$?」

550:t_1:126.en:
$$オルソン$$
「I think it was to stop $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$'s plan, but...」

550:t_1:127.en:
$$カレン$$
「Then they should stop doing things halfway and fight properly...」

550:t_1:128.en:
$$桂$$
「Knowing $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, he may have decided to watch from the sidelines.」

550:t_1:129.en:
$$桂$$
「And that power of his... It might belong to a being beyond human... one of those so-called higher-dimensional life forms.」

550:t_1:130.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「That man... Did he really become our enemy after all?」

550:t_1:131.en:
$$桂$$
「What's with you, $$ミレーヌ$$? You still believe in him?」

550:t_1:132.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「It's not that, but I just can't bring myself to believe he's a bad person...」

550:t_1:133.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I can understand how you feel.」

550:t_1:135.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...I can't explain it well, but part of me wants to believe in $$アドヴェント#pilot$$...」

550:t_1:136.en:
$$クラン$$
「Perhaps that man... is putting us through a trial?」

550:t_1:137.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「A trial, huh... Thanks, but no thanks.」

550:t_1:138.en:
$$ルカ$$
「But if you think of it that way, some things start to make sense.」

550:t_1:139.en:
$$カレン$$
「Even if that's true, $$テッサ$$ and $$宗介$$ might have died because of the Reformists if things had gone badly.」

550:t_1:140.en:
$$カレン$$
「And it's not their fault, but in that battle, $$クルツ$$ was...」

550:t_1:142.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「$$クルツ$$... He was always cheerful, the mood maker of the team...」

550:t_1:143.en:
$$レド$$
「Precisely because of a situation like this, that man's banter was reassuring...」

550:t_1:144.en:
$$ミシェル$$
(Once again... I've lost a sniper I looked up to...)

550:t_1:145.en:
$$クロウ$$
(Leaving behind the woman he fell for and going on ahead, huh... You've really got the short-straw luck, $$クルツ$$...)

550:t_1:146.en:
$$アルト$$
「Even if they weren't the direct cause, I can't forgive what the Reformists did, not emotionally...」

550:t_1:147.en:
$$桂$$
「And I don't like how he treated $n like his own possession, either.」

550:t_1:149.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Leave him be. ...Looks like he ran into that ex-girlfriend of his at $$ヤムスク$$.」

550:t_1:151.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Are you thinking about that $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ person?」

550:t_1:152.en:
$n
「I think there's no point in thinking about him.」

550:t_1:155.en:
$n
($$クルツ$$... Since before there was $c, I've been indebted to you the whole time...)

550:t_1:156.en:
$n
(Because you covered me, even an amateur like me somehow managed to fight...)

550:t_1:157.en:
$n
(Thank you, $$クルツ$$... I'll never forget you.)

550:t_1:158.en:
$$ティティ$$
「...Do you still like $$マキ#pilot$$?」

550:t_1:160.en:
$n
「But... it's a fact that $$マキ#pilot$$ helped me when I was in a bad place mentally.」

550:t_1:161.en:
$n
「Even if $$マキ#pilot$$ approached me on a $$クロノ$$ mission, I don't intend to forget that.」

550:t_1:162.en:
$$ティティ$$
「You're lucky, $n. Surrounded by $$マキ#pilot$$ and Miss $$スズネ$$.」

550:t_1:163.en:
$n
「I'm grateful to you too, $$ティティ$$.」

550:t_1:164.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Even if it's just flattery, hearing you say that makes me happy.」

550:t_1:165.en:
$n
(I was able to get back on my feet thanks to my comrades...)

550:t_1:166.en:
$n
($$宗介$$... I'm counting on you to look after $$マオ$$.)

550:t_1:170.en: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Mess Hall ～

550:t_1:171.en:
$$宗介$$
「...So this is where you were.」
